component.name: Sing-Along
component.summary: Lyric sync for your own music files

description.p: Sing-Along plays the music files you already have and finds timed lyrics for them, so the words scroll with the song instead of sitting in a separate window.

It looks up lyrics on LRCLIB, with NetEase as an optional second source, and saves them next to your audio files or inside their tags. When a match is wrong or missing a line, the editor lets you move a line or an individual word to the right moment and hear the result as you go.
Exports are aimed at the device that will show them: plain LRC, enhanced LRC with word-level tags, and TTML, which several phone players and car head units read for word-by-word display.
For Chinese-language libraries, timing and text can be converted between Simplified and Traditional without the lyrics themselves being altered or translated.
The same binary also runs headless for scripts: fetch, export, status and formats, with no window and no desktop session.

description.p: The release that made every platform build reliably: a signed Windows installer pipeline, a workflow that lints itself before spending an hour building, and a command line that knows whether it was installed by a package manager before offering to upgrade itself.
